overview_description.description:
Orange Jordan is a telecommunications operator that provides the latest in innovative solutions and services.

Orange Jordan is the backbone of the ICT sector in the Kingdom and is committed to carrying the banner of work that His Majesty King Abdullah II has launched to develop the sector by embodying its vision to transform the Kingdom into a regional ICT hub by providing the latest in innovative solutions and services. To meet the ambitions and needs of its national and business customers at the national level, and to connect them with everything that is necessary for them, thus contributing to its position as the strongest provider of high-speed Internet in the market. Orange Jordan continues to move forward with its efforts to invest in the future of Jordan and its children by introducing the latest technology into it and by strengthening its infrastructure to make these technologies a reality and accessible to all.

Orange Jordan provides leading and integrated telecommunications services throughout the Kingdom, offering individuals and the corporate sector a wide range of fixed and mobile services and internet services. Orange Jordan is focused on delivering an unrivaled connectivity and communication experience to all its customers through its next-generation networks that include 4G, LTE, LTE-M, LTE-IoT, FTTH, For the FTTB business, as well as the Multimedia Multimedia Subsystem (IP) subsystem.
